Solution 1 is the only one with a derivation that holds together. Its discriminant, (d-3)² - 4d = (d-1)(d-9), and its check at d = 9 (u = 3, s₁ = 3 < s₀ ≈ 3.343) are arithmetically consistent. It is still unverified: I did not confirm the transition rates or the eigenfunction ansatz against the averaging process. Solutions 2 and 3 rest on heuristic thresholds that I could not justify, so I rate them as unlikely.
